title: i.MX6 Demo Board: MT41K256M16TW-107 U9 to MCIMX6Y2CVM08AB U7
description: A spacious multilayer benchmark reproducing 53 exact DDR3-to-BGA endpoint pairs from i.MX6 Demo Board.

referenceDesign.extractionMethod: Exact KiCad PCB pad/net traversal; a single two-pad series resistor may be collapsed into one benchmark connection and is recorded per path.

placement.componentGapDefinition: minimum horizontal clearance between the physical pad-field edges

feasibility.focus: fan out both real BGA footprints, then route the exact reference DDR3 endpoint pairs
feasibility.viaStyle: 0.336 mm dogbone-compatible via pad; via-in-pad disabled
